t: Endergenic power is timing based. A Pearl Injector creates an endergenic pearl, generators catch and fire it, and good timing turns the pearl arrival into FE.
末影能发电基于精确时机控制。末影珍珠填充器生成末影能珍珠，发电机负责捕获并发射该珍珠，而精准的时机把控可将珍珠抵达瞬间高效转化为FE。
A basic setup needs at least two Endergenic Generators, one Pearl Injector, redstone timing, and a destination set with a wrench.
基础配置至少需要两台末影能发电机、一台末影珍珠填充器、红石定时装置，以及通过扳手设定的目的地。
Generator states: Idle waits. Charging can receive a pearl. Holding means a pearl was captured and is consuming FE until it is fired again.
发电机状态说明：空闲（Idle）表示等待；充能（Charging）表示可接收末影珍珠；持留（Holding）表示已捕获珍珠，正持续消耗FE直至再次发射。
Step 1: pulse the Pearl Injector to inject a pearl into the first generator. Step 2: pulse that generator to fire the pearl toward its paired generator.
第一步：向末影珍珠填充器发送脉冲，使其向首台发电机注入一枚珍珠；第二步：向该发电机发送脉冲，令其将珍珠射向配对的另一台发电机。
Step 3: pulse the receiving generator into Charging before the pearl arrives. The ideal capture point is tick 10 of its 15-tick charging cycle.
第三步：在珍珠抵达前，向接收端发电机发送脉冲使其进入充能状态。理想捕获点为其15刻充能周期中的第10刻。
Step 4: fire the pearl onward quickly. A held pearl costs FE every tick and can be lost if held too long or if the generator runs out of power.
第四步：迅速发射珍珠。持留状态下的珍珠每刻均消耗FE，若持留过久或发电机断电，珍珠即告丢失。
Use a wrench to pair generators. The chat message shows travel time in ticks, up to 4 ticks. That travel time is the key value for your redstone timing.
使用扳手配对发电机。聊天信息将显示传输耗时（单位：刻），最长为4刻。该传输耗时即为你红石计时的关键值。
Ender Monitors help automate timing by watching generator state. Even well-tuned setups can lose pearls, so keep pearl supply and startup logic in mind.
末影显示器通过监测发电机状态协助自动化时机控制。即使经过精细调校的系统仍可能丢失珍珠，因此请务必兼顾珍珠供应与启动逻辑设计。
